race.comment: SERILO (9) on top after resuming with a third at Bordertown, beaten two and a half lengths after getting busy late, while her previous Mdn run had excuses after being hampered and racing wide on heavy ground. PIKLEMEGRANMOTHER (8) looks the main threat despite a plain sixth at Hamilton last start, with the wide run noted by stewards giving some context. Her earlier fourth in a Mdn at Warrnambool was sound, and three placings from four starts at this track put her right in this. CALM THE PRESS (1) has been only fair at his past two, but he rates well enough this campaign and the Naracoorte run had some merit after racing wide without cover. In the mix. HARD AND FORST (12) is a debut filly from the Tom Dabernig stable, has trialled two weeks ago, and her $52,500 yearling purchase profile makes her a genuine market watch.
